description: Adapter continuation thread_id is retained in receipts but dropped by History.Delivery; TranscriptHistory uses input placement unconditionally. Extend existing confirmed-delivery path to preserve thread_id and resolve matching child transcript under authorized root, without provider-specific logic. Add regression through DeliveryConfirmation -> Engine -> HistoryIngress, assert child placement and parent, replay idempotence. No new Action; reuse existing confirmation and transcript storage.
title: Preserve delivery thread placement in canonical history
